input_nodes.name: history_6m
input_nodes.description: Sequence of last 6 continuous monthly electricity usage values in kWh ordered chronologically [t-5, t-4, t-3, t-2, t-1, t0].

internal_transforms.input_transform: softplus_inv: z = where(y > 20.0, y, y + log(-expm1(-(y + eps))))
internal_transforms.normalization: standard: center = mean(z, dim=-1), scale = clamp(std(z, dim=-1, ddof=0), min=1e-7), x_norm = (z - center) / scale
internal_transforms.network_blocks: 2 generic N-BEATS stacks (2 dense layers per block, width 32, expansion length 16)

output_nodes.name: prediction_kwh
output_nodes.interpretation: Point forecast for target month in kWh (strictly non-negative and finite).
